description: Every one of an airplane's own figures with the range it may take, in the form's order: the one statement of them (engine/crates/pilot/src/aircraft/form.rs), which aircraft_problems checks the "Your Airplane" form against and the planner builds its query parameters' bounds from, so a figure the form and the gateway take is one every plan takes. Each is a sanity bound that keeps a typo out of the plan, no regulation or handbook figure: above min (or at it where min_inclusive) and at most max.

field.description: The form's and the gateway's name, cruiseTasKt.

label.description: The field's name in the form's words, Cruise speed.

unit.description: kt, gal/h, gal, %, ft, fpm, or empty for a ratio.

min_inclusive.description: min itself is inside; otherwise only above it.

required.description: The form needs it (the cruise speed and burn).
